source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the appeal grounded in plural mercies and the embodied sacrificial image.
key_decisions.before: Therefore I urge you, brothers and sisters, by God’s mercies, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God. This is your fitting worship.
key_decisions.after: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, by God's mercies, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your reasonable worship.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore I urge you, brothers and sisters, through the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your fitting service.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the repeated think language, sober self-assessment, and individual measure.
key_decisions.before: By the grace given to me, I tell everyone among you not to think more highly of yourself than you ought to think, but to think with sober judgment, each according to the measure of trust God has assigned.
key_decisions.after: For by the grace given to me, I say to everyone among you: do not think of yourself more highly than you ought to think, but think with sound judgment, according to the measure of faith God has assigned to each person.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For by the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think more highly than one ought to think, but to think with sober judgment, each according to the measure of faith that God has assigned.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps grace-gift wordplay and the difficult faith proportion phrase.
key_decisions.before: We have different gifts according to the grace given to us: if prophecy, use it according to the proportion of trust;
key_decisions.after: We have different gifts according to the grace given to us: if prophecy, use it according to the proportion of faith;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Having gifts that differ according to the grace given to us, let us use them: if prophecy, according to the proportion of faith;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps each gift paired with its manner of exercise.
key_decisions.before: if encouragement, in encouraging; the one who gives, with generosity; the one who leads, with diligence; the one who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
key_decisions.after: if one encourages, in encouragement; the one who gives, with generosity; the one who leads, with diligence; the one who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: the one who exhorts, in exhortation; the one who gives, with generosity; the one who leads, with diligence; the one who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves shared-mindedness, the ambiguous lowly referent, and self-wisdom warning.
key_decisions.before: Live in harmony with one another. Do not set your mind on high things, but associate with the lowly. Do not become wise in your own estimation.
key_decisions.after: Live in harmony with one another. Do not set your minds on lofty things, but associate with the lowly. Do not become wise in your own estimation.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Be of the same mind toward one another; do not set your mind on high things, but associate with the lowly. Do not be wise in your own sight.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the affectionate address, prohibition, and divine claim on vengeance.
key_decisions.before: Beloved, do not avenge yourselves, but leave room for God’s wrath, because it is written, “Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”
key_decisions.after: Do not avenge yourselves, beloved, but leave room for God's wrath, for it is written: “Vengeance is mine; I will repay,” says the Lord.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Beloved, do not avenge yourselves, but give place to wrath, for it is written, “Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says the Lord.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains concrete care for an enemy and the unsettling coal image without explaining it away.
key_decisions.before: Instead, “If your enemy is hungry, feed them; if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. For by doing this you will heap burning coals on their head.”
key_decisions.after: Rather, “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink. For by doing this you will heap burning coals on his head.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But, “If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink; for in doing so you will heap burning coals on his head.”
